values: 发射封魔箭使一名敌人属性无法增加持续一段时间，并使目标永久降低护甲和魔抗。
Indris fires a silencing arrow at an enemy, preventing their stats from increasing for a while and reducing their Phys & Magic DEF for the rest of the battle.
朝一名敌人发射封魔箭，造成240% + 20% ATK伤害，使敌人的属性增益效果失效持续8秒，并使目标永久降低20%护甲和魔抗，该效果不可叠加。属性增益失效的效果对首领敌人无法生效。

Indris fires a silencing arrow at an enemy, dealing 240% + 20% ATK damage. The shot disables the enemy's stat buffs for 8s and reduces their Phys & Magic DEF by 20% for the rest of the battle. Unstackable. The buff-disabling effect doesn't work on Bosses.
对暴露弱点的目标释放封魔箭时，也能击破弱点额外造成其最大生命值20%的真实伤害，该伤害不超过500% ATK。
When Indris fires a silencing arrow at a target with exposed weakness, he deals extra true damage equal to 20% of the target's max HP. The true damage cannot exceed 500% ATK.
封魔箭伤害提高至260% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of silencing arrow to 260% + 20% ATK.
封魔箭伤害提高至280% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of silencing arrow to 280% + 20% ATK.
封魔箭伤害提高至300% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of silencing arrow to 300% + 20% ATK.
拥有多个来自不同友军的属性降低效果的敌人会暴露弱点，因度厄的普通攻击对暴露弱点的敌人造成额外真实伤害，并且能够同时发射3枚箭矢攻击敌人。

When an enemy is afflicted by multiple debuffs from Indris and his allies, the enemy's weakness is exposed. Indris' normal attack fires 3 arrows and deals extra true damage to enemies with exposed weakness.

被动地，当敌人拥有至少3个来自不同友军的属性降低类效果时会暴露弱点，因度厄的普通攻击能击破弱点造成额外60% + 6% ATK真实伤害，同一名敌人的弱点在4秒内至多被普通攻击击破1次。
此外，因度厄的普通攻击会同时发射3枚箭矢分别造成165% + 20% ATK伤害，优先攻击暴露弱点的不同目标，命中相同目标时后续伤害降低25%。

Passive. When an enemy is afflicted by at least 3 different stat reduction debuffs from Indris or his allies, the enemy's weakness is exposed. Indris' normal attacks deal 60% + 6% ATK extra true damage to enemies with exposed weaknesses. This effect can trigger once every 4s per enemy.
In addition, Indris' normal attack fires 3 arrows, each dealing 165% + 20% ATK damage. The arrows prioritize different enemies with exposed weaknesses. If all 3 arrows hit the same target, the second and third arrows deal 25% less damage.
普通攻击每枚箭矢的伤害提高至170% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each arrow triggered with True Sight to 170% + 20% ATK.
普通攻击每枚箭矢的伤害提高至175% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each arrow triggered with True Sight to 175% + 20% ATK.
普通攻击每枚箭矢的伤害提高至180% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each arrow triggered with True Sight to 180% + 20% ATK.
将周围敌人击退至一定距离外，并扔出捕网定身一名最近的敌人。
Indris knocks back nearby enemies, then casts a binding spell that immobilizes the nearest enemy.
将周围敌人击退至距离自身2格以外的位置，随后朝距离最近的一名敌人扔出捕网，造成170% + 20% ATK伤害并将其定身5秒。

Indris knocks back all enemies within 2 tiles, pushing them out of the 2-tile area surrounding him. He then casts a binding spell on the nearest enemy, dealing 170% + 20% ATK damage and immobilizing them for 5s.
Increases the damage dealt to 180% + 20% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 190% + 20% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 200% + 20% ATK.
提高自身攻击力，有敌人暴露弱点时额外提高攻击力。
Indris increases his ATK during battle, which increases further if any enemy has an exposed weakness.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高6%，有敌人暴露弱点时额外提高9%攻击力。
Indris increases his ATK by 6% during battle, plus an extra 9% ATK if any enemy has exposed weakness.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高8%，有敌人暴露弱点时额外提高12%攻击力。
Indris increases his ATK by 8% during battle, plus an extra 12% ATK if any enemy has exposed weakness.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提高10%，有敌人暴露弱点时额外提高15%攻击力。
Indris increases his ATK by 10% during battle, plus an extra 15% ATK if any enemy has exposed weakness.
因度厄每次击破弱点后提高自身攻击速度，持续一段时间。
Each time Indris triggers the exposed weakness damage bonus, he increases his ATK SPD for a period of time.
因度厄每次击破弱点时使自身提高40点攻击速度，持续6秒，不可叠加。
Each time Indris triggers the exposed weakness damage bonus, he increases his ATK SPD by 40 for 6s. Unstackable.
击破弱点时的攻击速度加成提高至50点。
Increases the ATK SPD Indris gains when triggering the exposed weakness damage bonus to 50.
因度厄的普通攻击会使目标降低20%护甲，持续6秒，不可叠加。
Indris' normal attacks reduce the target's Phys DEF by 20% for 6s. Unstackable.
击破弱点时的攻击速度加成提高至60点。
Increases the ATK SPD Indris gains when triggering the exposed weakness damage bonus to 60.
技能“拘缚投网”发射捕网命中敌人后，因度厄击破其弱点不受冷却时间限制持续一段时间。
After hitting an enemy with Arcane Binding, Indris can trigger the exposed weakness damage without cooldown for a while.
技能“拘缚投网”发射的捕网命中目标后，因度厄的普通攻击击破其弱点不受冷却时间限制，持续5秒。
After hitting a target with Arcane Binding, Indris' normal attacks can trigger the exposed weakness damage bonus without cooldown for 5s.
击破弱点的4秒内，普通攻击对被击破弱点的敌人射出的每根箭矢将附带目标最大生命值5%的物理伤害，至多不超过自身攻击力150%。

Within 4s after Indris breaks an enemy's weakness, each of his normal attack arrow that hits the affected enemy deals extra physical damage equal to 5% of the enemy's max HP. The damage cannot exceed 150% of Indris' ATK.
